summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Financial Management system. All 7 backend API endpoints working correctly (16/16 tests passed after fixing MongoDB _id serialization bug). Frontend UI fully functional with all 4 tabs (Balance Sheet, Obligations, Unit Payments, Expenses), month/year filters, and modals working correctly. Unit payment status colors (green=paid, red=unpaid) verified. Mark Paid functionality tested and working - updates status, records payment date, and creates revenue record.

issues: Some labels show English while others show Arabic (e.g., 'Maintenance' vs 'صيانة') - should be consistent based on selected language

action_items: Minor: Ensure all category labels are translated consistently when Arabic is selected
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (line 13337 - fixed MongoDB _id serialization in expense creation)
seed_data_creation: Created test obligations and expenses during backend testing (TEST_Obligation_*, TEST_Expense_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Financial Management feature fully tested. Page accessible at /app/finances. All CRUD operations for obligations, unit charges, and expenses working. Mark Paid functionality creates revenue records. Notify Unpaid sends notifications to residents with pending charges.

POST /api/financial/obligations.description: Creates obligation and distributes equally to all units

GET /api/financial/unit-charges.description: Returns charges with paid/unpaid status and summary

PUT /api/financial/unit-charges/{id}/pay.description: Marks charge as paid, records payment date, creates revenue

POST /api/financial/unit-charges/notify-.description: Sends notifications to units with pending charges

GET /api/financial/balance-sheet.description: Returns complete balance sheet with revenue, expenses, obligations summary

POST /api/financial/expenses.description: Adds expense record (fixed MongoDB _id serialization bug)

mark_paid_functionality.description: Updates status to green, records payment date, creates revenue, updates collection rate

notify_unpaid_functionality.description: Sends notifications and shows toast with count

bug_fixed.root_cause: MongoDB _id (ObjectId) was included in response after insert_one(), which is not JSON serializable
bug_fixed.fix: Added expense.pop('_id', None) before returning response in server.py line 13337
